list.q: Do you work on all types of residential window glass?
list.a: Yes — single-pane, double-pane insulated units, tempered safety glass, laminated glass, and high-impact glass. If you're not sure what you have, we'll identify it when we come out to measure.

list.q: My window is foggy between the panes — is that fixable?
list.a: That fogging means the seal on your insulated unit has failed. The glass itself can't be cleaned — the whole unit needs to be replaced. We cut a new insulated unit to match your existing frame. It's a common job, usually done in a single visit.

list.q: Do you do emergency or same-day service?
list.a: We do our best for broken or security-compromised situations. Call us directly and we'll tell you honestly how fast we can get there. For standard replacements, we're typically scheduled within 2–4 business days.

list.q: How do I know what size glass to order?
list.a: You don't need to know — we come out and measure everything before we order. A precise measurement is critical for a proper fit, and we never skip that step.
Yes. We carry general liability and workers' compensation coverage and are happy to provide proof before any job. Most homeowners ask, and we expect it.
